name: External-Style Adversarial Stress Tests
purpose: Stress-test RFPR theorem packages against external-review failure modes and semantic collapse risks.

test_classes.notes: No proof step assumes global closure or infinite scale.
All local restricted assumptions (A1-A3) are well-defined.
Counterexamples are actively linked and prominently displayed.
Notation remains consistent with the normalized symbol set.
No collapse of ⇔R into equality or implication detected.
Language avoids reification of process relations.
Incompleteness is declared as a structural feature.

governance_rules.rule: Adversarial stress tests must simulate external skepticism regarding locality and inseparability.
